annotations.title: Get a server's tools by kind

description: Gives the tool names on one tracked vendor MCP server, grouped by the most serious thing each tool is counted as able to do: money (move or spend money), destructive (changes that cannot be undone, such as deleting), send (send messages or publish to other people), write (create or change things), unclear, or read (labelled as only reading). Labels come from Stackduke's open-source scanner: the server's own annotations where it sends them, otherwise a guess from the tool's name that leans to the more serious kind. They are not verified by calling the tools, and they do not mean a server is safe. Tool descriptions are never included. A server the tracker does not follow gets a 'not covered' answer.

kind.description: Optional. Only the tools counted as this kind.

vendor.description: The server, by id or name, for example "huggingface" or "Microsoft Learn".

name: get_server_capabilities

data_as_of.description: When the tracker data was published.
